tests.type: source review; warmup and image equality
tests.result: One unmeasured render warmup per frame workload and one unmeasured operation per visibility workload precede measured loops. Each measured frame must equal its warmup and have zero unsupported pixels or the script throws before writing the final report. StudyImage synthesized Equatable includes full RGBA Data, dimensions, unsupported count and validity-mask Data. The final report is consistent with those guards; repeated buffers are not separately retained in JSON and were not independently rerendered.

No benchmark rerun, Swift compile, full suite, native app, Metal, device, UI, memory, thermal or sustained frame-rate execution. Timing has no portable acceptance threshold. outcome: No confirmed material defect.
